title: Mining stocks are the new market darlings, fueled by geopolitical risks and AI demand
title_zh: 在地缘政治风险和人工智能需求的推动下，矿业股成为市场新宠
summary: Mining stocks are rising as the sector becomes a strategic long-term asset for investors.
summary_zh: 随着矿业股成为投资者的战略性长期资产，矿业股正在上涨。

title: This moment of AI disruption is full of mixed messages
title_zh: 人工智能颠覆的这一时刻充满了复杂的信息
summary: When the economy gets to the other side of the AI transformation, it will be hard to tell if the markets are winner-take-all or if the winners are simply standing over the wreckage.
summary_zh: 当经济发展到人工智能转型的另一边时，很难判断市场是赢家通吃还是赢家只是站在废墟上。
